user.title: LibreLinkUp
user.description: Enter the credentials of your LibreLinkUp account. For Home Assistant, using a separate LibreLinkUp account created specifically for this integration is recommended.

connection.title: Select LibreLinkUp connection
connection.description: This LibreLinkUp account has access to multiple people. Select the person whose glucose data should be used.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate LibreLinkUp
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current password for your LibreLinkUp account.

error.no_connections: No LibreLinkUp connections were found for this account.
error.share_revoked: This person is no longer sharing their glucose data with this LibreLinkUp account.
error.unsupported_region: This LibreLinkUp account is hosted in a region this integration does not support.
error.account_state: LibreLinkUp accepted the request but refused the login. Open the LibreLinkUp app and check whether the account has to confirm something, such as new terms of use.
error.invalid_response: LibreLinkUp returned data this integration could not read. The API may have changed.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This LibreLinkUp connection is already configured.

share_revoked.title: LibreLinkUp share removed
share_revoked.description:
The person configured in "{entry_title}" no longer shares their glucose data with this LibreLinkUp account, so their entities are unavailable.

Share the data again in the LibreLinkUp app, or remove this entry from Home Assistant.

account_state.title: LibreLinkUp login refused
account_state.description:
LibreLinkUp refused the login for the account used by "{entry_title}", for a reason a new password cannot fix.

Open the LibreLinkUp app and check whether the account has to confirm something, such as new terms of use, and whether it is still active.

legacy_entry.title: LibreLinkUp entry has no person selected
legacy_entry.description:
The entry "{entry_title}" was created before this integration stored which person it belongs to, so it cannot be loaded without risking data from the wrong person.

Remove the entry and add it again.
